# s323 — Items waiting on an owner decision are held out of next

An item flagged `needs-owner` is held out of `next` and listed by `status`, and `slicer decide ID --text "…"` records the owner's answer as a `decision` note and clears the flag.

**Findings:** outer-session wishlist 2026-10-16, item 2: open decisions lived in prose, so next showed s312 as ready · **Size:** M · **Tree:** slicer

**Not in this slice:** turning the existing prose decisions into flags (the owner does that with `set --add-flag`); a TUI view.

## Why

On 2026-10-16 s312, s316 and s318 each carried an open owner decision as prose ("**Owner decision (open):**") inside their Why section. `next --ready` treated them as ready, and the outer session found its blockers only by remembering them or searching the text. AGENTS.md treats design decisions as the owner's, so a relay that picks such an item has to stop mid-run. The project already has flags (`set --add-flag`), but flags affect only the sync pointers (`exclude_flags`, docs/configuration.md:119), and the documented way to hold an item back is a custom status, which would hide its real status (open or started).

## Files

- `src/slicer/config.py`: a `hold_flags` key, a list that defaults to `["needs-owner"]`; `[]` turns holding off. Documented in `docs/configuration.md`.
- `src/slicer/ops.py` and `src/slicer/cli.py`:
  - `next` and `next --batch` skip items carrying any hold flag and return them under `held` (id, title, flags), as they do with `blocked`.
  - `status` lists held items in their own block.
  - `list` gains `--held`.
- `src/slicer/cli.py`: `decide ID --text TEXT` (or `--file`/`--stdin`) appends a note of kind `decision` and removes every hold flag from the item.
  - `decide` on an item with no hold flag is `usage`, with a message naming the flags.
  - `decision` joins the built-in note kinds; if a project restricts `note_kinds`, `decide` still writes its own kind.
- `src/slicer/render.py` / the row template: a held item's row shows the flag (it already shows flags, so this may need no change; confirm).
- `docs/commands.md`, `docs/agents.md` (`next` payload `held`, the `decide` command), `slicer ai instructions` (filing: flag an open decision with `needs-owner` instead of only writing prose), `CHANGELOG.md` under Added.
- `tests/test_next.py`, `tests/test_decide.py`.
